subject: literacy
concept: Completing a full independent capstone literary thesis from question through final polished essay, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 literacy sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student tracks their capstone progress through question/research/outline/draft/revision stages
exercise.abstract: Student completes an independent literary capstone thesis: an original arguable question, researched and cited support, addressed counterargument, and a polished final essay

assessment.mastery_threshold: capstone demonstrates all stages: original thesis, evidence integration, counterargument handling, and polished, properly cited writing
misconception_flags: completes individual stages competently but the final essay doesn't cohere into one sustained argument

interest_binding: full capstone topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
